title: Commit ticfac's install block into image/Dockerfile so a plain build.sh image boots
description:
Since 46x the image scripts call `ticfac sandbox …`, but only the deploy's staged Dockerfile installs ticfac (internal/factory/ticfacbin.go); a hand `./build.sh` image has no ticfac and its entrypoint stops at resolve_substrate. ticfacbin.go already notes the fold into image/ is now possible since r6w; it should land, with the binaries still staged by the deploy.

ticfac run epic-6in filed this backlog tick from the finding b87b11592e24cde9ef4b3a10ff7f1cd56d2158c903a3bc7ad323ef6aca508977 (reported by run-epic-6in/tick-46x/attempt-4): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-6in/absorptions/b87b11592e24cde9ef4b3a10ff7f1cd56d2158c903a3bc7ad323ef6aca508977.json on the run branch.
